notes.backtest: Backtest: the frozen model scored on dates it never traded, after the fact. A description of the holdout, not evidence — only live days are evidence.
notes.execution: Implementable: the next session's open to the open after it — an execution one day behind the signal, holding through the following night. Sector-excess, centered within each date. This is the only leg reported: the record's credited close-to-close entry is taken at the 16:00 close of a date whose signal is committed at 18:30, so no execution can obtain it. Costs at the open are not measured.
